sections.text_helper: Section 27.5 "AES interrupts" in chapter 27 (AES hardware accelerator (AES)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 822.
sections.section_content:
There are multiple individual maskable interrupt sources generated by the AES peripheral to
signal the following events:
• computation completed (CCF)
• read error (RDERRF)
• write error (WRERRF)
• key error (KEIF)
See Section27.4.18: AES error management for details on AES errors.
These sources are combined into a common interrupt signal from the AES peripheral that
connects to the Cortex® CPU interrupt controller. Application can enable or disable AES
interrupt sources individually by setting/clearing the corresponding enable bit of the
AES_IER register.
The status of the individual maskable interrupt sources can be read from the AES_ISR
register. They are cleared by setting the corresponding bit of the AES_ICR register.
Table213 gives a summary of the available features.
